title: an ancestor instanceof test is always true in an if condition

ground_truth.statement: RuntimeException extends Exception, so every permitted argument enters the true branch. The condition is always true and the false return is unreachable. Unlike the bare-return companion, this fixture tests a conditional reporting context.

allowed.reason: Every argument takes the true branch and returns, so the final false return is unreachable. This is a correct consequence of the constant condition.

notes: This control separates conditional diagnostics from the optional choice to warn on bare returned Boolean expressions. The expected constant value comes from PHP inheritance, not tool output.
